Method of Attack: Posing as games with no legitimate functionality
Removing app icon immediately after installation
Silently downloading another app from a hardcoded address
Tricking user into approving installation of the downloaded app
Displaying unsolicited advertisements when device is unlocked
Requesting permissions for full network access, viewing network connections, and running at startup
Attack Vector: Google Play Store installation of fraudulent apps
Indicators of Compromise: Hardcoded download link for Game Center app (no longer available)
Low detection rate on VirusTotal with only four antivirus engines detecting it
Over 560,000 combined installations of the fraudulent apps
